supersedes: prereg-dsx-t16-cold-hot-init.json: VRAM increase >1 GiB required on each card
reason: The first startup log enumerated both RTX 3090s, and nvidia-smi pmon observed the DSX process as a CUDA compute client on GPU0 and GPU1 while VRAM allocation was highly asymmetric. A symmetric VRAM threshold would incorrectly reject this runtime's documented main/aux placement.
revised_gate: At readiness, nvidia-smi pmon must report this exact DSX server PID with type C on both GPU indices 0 and 1. Save the pmon output and VRAM snapshots as separate evidence; do not require symmetric VRAM allocation.
no_measurement_claimed: The first process was intentionally stopped before readiness when the invalid memory-allocation gate was discovered. It contributes no cold or hot startup time.
